warnings: Surface location is approximate. The distance threshold is a visualization correspondence tolerance, not physical sensor accuracy.
Friction-anchor vectors are retained; complete contact torsional moments and six-axis wrenches are not measured.

limitations: Control-state sampling is not continuous collision detection or an all-physics-substep audit. AABB candidate selection supplies lower bounds only; exact reported minima cover sampled states only.
Adjacent source collision assemblies across collider-free virtual links and the exact seven official pairs are listed and excluded; no other cross-finger pairs are suppressed.
FCL triangle witness depth is not a reliable maximum volumetric penetration. Mesh intersection is not a solid-containment proof, especially for nonwatertight meshes.
Intended thumb/index elastomer versus assigned blade intersections remain separately reported; contact quality and broad-face force must come from physics.
URDF joint FK omits solver joint compliance. PhysX convex collision approximations may differ from the source triangles.
Arm, table and block checks belong to the separate full-control geometry validator. This report does not assert task success.

media.tactile_sampling: Every physics substep, dt-weighted mean per video interval
media.tactile_visualization: Nearest-surface force bins; linear shared colour scales; no spatial smoothing. Contact location glyphs enlarged for legibility; their area is not physical contact area.
media.contact_note: 中指侧边承托；表面图为近似投影

limitations: Finite simulation experiments; no hardware validation or full-workspace guarantee.
Material friction, actuator gains and rigid contact models are uncalibrated simulation assumptions.
Tactile maps show actual PhysX normal/friction forces projected to official W01 surfaces in N/bin, not pressure or hardware sensor images.
The older official tactile map differs locally from the current hand mesh; out-of-map force remains in the raw records.
No runtime object teleportation, robot-tool attachment or external grasp force is used.
The initial withdrawal speed setting is a nominal target before acceleration smoothing, not a strict speed cap. Any observed exceedance is retained in the feedback audit.

Source mesh intersections occur in the middle support region. Their original counts and independently measured depths are retained; this is not a claim of zero source penetration or continuous upward support.

30 source-intersection control states lack a matching measured middle contact. Exact source geometry is fully measured, but the stricter contact-matching review remains false; these states are preserved as a source/solver discrepancy, not counted as verified support.

Failed cases remain failures under the original task criteria. See each failed_episodes entry and the independent gate audit for the final phase and measured forces; being near the goal alone is not success.

The middle finger has real upward support during parts of the task, but release contact reorganization produces downward force: phase mean -2.089 N and minimum -5.746 N. Full data and video peaks are retained.
Broad-face validity is 98.96 percent of recorded active control states, with 16 nonqualifying samples during release. The final grasp satisfies the unchanged task criteria.
The two fresh-case failures occur before release: lift target-tracking error reaching a wrist-command bound, and transfer delay near a wrist singularity. See the frozen independent diagnosis.

review.method:
Join immutable source, actual-contact and exact-depth evidence for one video.

Review completeness is not a zero-penetration statement or a new contact filter.
Task success, force direction, source intersections, and geometry approximation
are reported separately.
review.depth_metric: Maximum over every point on the source triangle surface of min(box_half_extent - abs(point-box_center)); positive values quantify source surface inside the rectangular blade solid. Exact triangle-barycentric linear optimization, millimeter scaling, HiGHS solver.

independent_source_part_attribution.interpretation: A projected taxel does not establish physical skin contact. The 3 mm display correspondence threshold can include shell/convex-hull contacts near the elastomer.

limitations: review_complete means the listed intersection cases have been individually quantified and matched to measured lower-side middle contacts, while other source intersection classes are zero; it does not assert zero source penetration or an arbitrary acceptable depth.
Support force can change sign during unloading/retraction. Actual contact and positive upward support are not synonymous; endpoint and all-substep force summaries are retained.
A merged middle DP rigid body includes shell and elastomer. Independent actual-sensor-frame surface distances, not the rigid-body name, describe closest original source part.
The exact depth metric concerns source surface inside the blade box; it is not collision volume, material strain, or a modification of simulator collision filters.
Geometry coverage is every active control endpoint; measured contact force classification separately covers every recorded active physics substep.

middle_support_full_run.evidence_label: Recorded run only; no transfer of evidence to another pose/version.

COM_model.assumption: Uniform density over authored straight-tool box volumes, no custom COM/inertia override.
COM_model.velocity: Finite differences of reconstructed world COM position.

declared_in_config.semantics: Measured C stable snapshot and cold-reset geometry; historical B static geometry is retained separately and does not describe the current gravity frame.

geometric_backup.meaning: Configuration geometry is a separate claim. Zero measured force does not verify or disprove a suitable backup position; measured support does not by itself validate source-mesh clearance.

source.force_scope: Every active env-0 physics substep, read one JSONL control record at a time.
source.retention_scope: Associated control-end grip/orientation measurements repeated over its substeps; not independent substep retention.
source.contact_link_scope: Actual raw normal-contact source links; aggregated-only records cannot identify individual links.

limitations: Only saved data is analyzed. This script applies no simulation forces, state writes, or controller changes.
Force vectors act on the tool; net upward force is normal plus friction. Signed and positive-only impulses are both reported.
Under-axis contact counts and net middle load are role-level evidence. Other simultaneous middle contacts can contribute to the net force.
World COM descent includes commanded arm motion. It proves tool slip only with a suitable matched, approximately fixed-wrist comparison.
A sustained-support flag is diagnostic, not a changed task success gate or proof of robust catch ability.
Task current JSONL covers environment 0 only. Probe role tensors cannot distinguish a middle MP contact from a fingertip sensor contact.
Time windows use sample-end times in (start, end]; impulses use the full corresponding physics-step duration.

natural_posture.support_counterfactual_scope: Same stable C/D normal posture; paired absolute closure .10 and .00 probe trials, not full pick-place tests and not proof of continuously upward middle force.
